description: Use this before touching a stock token on Robinhood Chain (NVDA, TSLA, SPY…): it tells whether a contract is the official Robinhood Stock Token or a copy using the same ticker. Returns the verdict (official, impostor with the official address, or not a stock token), the official ISIN, status, multiplier and any pending corporate action, the deepest pool price and liquidity, and the premium of that pool to the Chainlink feed of the token (the feed address and its last update; its value is not republished).

address.description: a token contract on Robinhood Chain, 0x followed by 40 hex characters

quote.description: true: return the price of this call without running or paying for it

symbol.description: or a ticker (NVDA, TSLA, SPY…) to get the official contract
